directive.quote: Main assigned Storage9 missing-contract paths; please own ONLY metadata for src/account/account_routes/recovery_source.rs, src/account/records_result.rs, src/server/records_result.rs and src/server.rs. No .rs changes.
directive.source: Authorized coordinator metadata assignment, not a new person message.

preserve: The existing native HTTP adapter exposes only its host-configured account/resource through the injected Records contract.
Owner-private bearer, loopback listener/Host and browser-origin refusal precede dispatch; body/page limits and continuation remain bounded.
Blocking record work remains away from asynchronous workers, and this OS-user surface does not replace native account rights.
allowed_deltas: This adapter existed in the same native source path at the pinned pre-policy commit. Current source reflows existing statements and exposes the separate shared tool_http_response child module; it does not add a records-result route here.

NEW tool text/download response encoding is owned by src/server/tool_http_response.rs and its callers, not by this fixed-scope server. This contract covers only preservation of the containing native adapter and its module integration.
No retired JavaScript file is asserted to be the source of this already-native adapter; no historical copy or source-first retention pass is claimed.
banned_substitutions: Invented byte-copy ancestry, a new result store, or a claim that metadata itself proves installed/customer behavior.

baseline.source_state: Metadata recorded after implementation. The pinned sources are behavioral evidence; no source-first copy or new test execution is claimed.

proof.qualification: Source-qualified metadata only. Existing committed controls are cited; this DATA-only lane launches no Cargo suite.
